description: JSON payload template for logging a verified troubleshooting case study to POST /api/kb/{parentSlug}/problems
title: Cloudflare Worker Terminated with Out of Memory (128MB Ceiling) During Large JSON Stream Parsing
errorSnippet:
Error: Worker exceeded memory limit (128 MiB).
    at JSON.parse (<anonymous>)
    at handleStreamChunk (worker.js:142:21)
    at async dispatchFetch (runtime:31:9)
environment: Cloudflare Workers workerd runtime, Node 22 compat, Astro 5 SSR, D1 SQLite
rootCause: The worker buffered an entire 150MB multi-part audio payload into a single Buffer in isolate heap memory before running JSON.parse(), breaching the hard 128MB memory limit per Cloudflare Worker isolate.
